gen-audiowide-gf-noto-serif-ottoman-siya: Audiowide draws its futuristic letters with a constant-width line, like tiles set with wide grout. And Noto Serif Ottoman Siyaq follows with a dignified text serif whose thin parts are only slightly slimmer than its stems.
gen-audiowide-gf-noto-serif-sinhala: Futuristic and tech-minded, Audiowide makes every diagonal as stout as every upright. Yet Noto Serif Sinhala moves in a gentle ebb and flow of stroke weight, giving the page a refined, bookish undertow.
gen-audiowide-gf-noto-serif-telugu: Traditional in feel, Audiowide's heading ribbon keeps a constant width through every glyph and curve. Noto Serif Telugu brings the opposite strength: a gentle thick to thin shift, with crossbars a touch thinner than the stems.
gen-audiowide-gf-noto-serif-thai: Noto Serif Thai reads bookish and authoritative, with big bodies and barely visible ascenders. Over a long stretch its mellow stroke weights stay firm without turning fragile, a steady counterpoint to the flat, calligraphy-free downstrokes of Audiowide.
gen-audiowide-gf-noto-serif-tibetan: Noto Serif Tibetan reads literary and assured, with a shift you feel more than see. Audiowide sits above it like stencil lettering of flat line weight, and the body's mellow swing from thick to thin softens it.
gen-audiowide-gf-noto-serif-todhri: Noto Serif Todhri brings a classic text serif with a sizable x-height built for screens. Audiowide has no hairlines to squint at, while Noto Serif Todhri adds a measured weight difference, like thread against yarn.
gen-audiowide-gf-noto-serif-toto: Every stroke in Audiowide is as stout as a drawn pipe cleaner, giving the heading a futuristic, tile-like look. Noto Serif Toto adds a hulking lowercase with a faint but real thick-thin shift.
gen-audiowide-gf-noto-serif-vithkuqi: Noto Serif Vithkuqi reads editorial and classic, with stems a touch heavier than its crossbars and big round bowls. Audiowide's curves match its stems exactly, so the modest stress below stands out.
gen-audiowide-gf-noto-serif-yezidi: Flat, futuristic, and humming along: that is Audiowide, with its constant line weight. But Noto Serif Yezidi supplies the text serif counterweight, a faint swell in each curve like pulled taffy, and words that read as solid blocks.
gen-audiowide-gf-odor-mean-chey: Odor Mean Chey reads dignified and editorial, with squeezed mouths. Its strongest quality is contrast with Audiowide, whose horizontals match its verticals while the text serif below stays tall and rounded.
